note: Reframing lenses for the divergence stage, written to apply to anything a session can be about - a product, a service, a story world, a game mechanic, a ritual, a campaign, a format. Where a line reads as if the thing had users or a budget, read it as whoever it is done to and whatever it costs them. Reframing lenses for the divergence stage. Three approaches drawn from three different categories cannot be variants of each other - which is the failure mode of the usual 'here are three options' move, where two are decoys. 'characteristic_failure' is a hint, not the answer: each approach must state how it would actually fail in this brief, and divergence_check.py rejects a set whose stated failure modes are the same failure wearing different words.

categories.label: Remove something the brief treats as essential
Reverse a relation the brief takes as fixed
Change who acts, decides, or is served
Change the size or granularity until the kind changes
Change when it happens, in what order, for how long
Change what is exchanged, priced, or owed
Design from upkeep, repair, and tending
Change the substrate the thing lives in
Make it a social form rather than a mechanism
Design backwards from the ending or the breakdown

frames.label: Delete the feature everyone assumes is the point
frames.move: Identify the one component the brief cannot imagine itself without, remove it, and make the rest carry the load.
frames.must_contain: What now does the work the deleted part was doing.
frames.characteristic_failure: The removed part comes back under a different name.

frames.label: It does exactly one thing and refuses the rest
frames.move: Cut to a single irreducible action and design the refusals explicitly.
frames.must_contain: The list of things it will not do even when asked.
frames.characteristic_failure: Too thin to matter to anyone.

frames.label: Remove the interface
frames.move: Assume nobody ever looks at this directly. It must work through what people already do, already own, or already leave behind.
frames.must_contain: The existing thing people already touch that carries it.
frames.characteristic_failure: Invisible to the point of being unaccountable - nobody can tell whether it worked.

frames.label: Nothing is kept
frames.move: Forbid accumulation: no history, no record, no archive. Everything must be reconstructed each time or forgotten.
frames.must_contain: What is lost on purpose, and who is protected by the loss.
frames.characteristic_failure: Nobody can pick up where they left off, so it happens once and never again.

frames.label: Reverse who serves whom
frames.move: The party that was served now does the serving; the tool asks and the user answers.
frames.must_contain: What the previously-served party now owes.
frames.characteristic_failure: Feels like a burden dressed as a feature.

frames.label: The abundant thing becomes scarce
frames.move: Whatever the brief assumes is unlimited - attention, room, invitations, second chances, daylight, forgiveness - becomes strictly rationed, and vice versa.
frames.must_contain: The ration and who sets it.
frames.characteristic_failure: Artificial scarcity that people quietly route around.

frames.label: The failure case is the product
frames.move: Treat the edge case, the rejection, the error path as the main experience and the happy path as an afterthought.
frames.must_contain: What the ordinary success case degrades into.
frames.characteristic_failure: Only interesting to whoever is already in trouble.

frames.label: Invert the default
frames.move: Whatever is opt-in becomes automatic and whatever is automatic requires a deliberate act.
frames.must_contain: The moment the deliberate act happens and what it costs.
frames.characteristic_failure: Consent problems: people are enrolled in something they did not choose.

frames.label: Built for the person who is not in the room
frames.move: Design for the party affected by this who never gets to use it - the person downstream, the one being described, the one who arrives later.
frames.must_contain: How that party's interest is enforced when they are absent.
frames.characteristic_failure: Whoever pays for it, decides on it, or has to carry it out sees nothing in it for themselves, so it never happens.

frames.label: Assume the user is hostile to it
frames.move: Design as if every participant is trying to extract advantage from it, including the operator.
frames.must_contain: What remains true even when everyone games it.
frames.characteristic_failure: So defensive that it is unpleasant for the honest majority.

frames.label: The unit is a group, not a person
frames.move: Nothing is owned, seen, or decided individually; the smallest addressable unit is a pair, a household, a shift, a team.
frames.must_contain: How disagreement inside the unit is handled.
frames.characteristic_failure: Individuals feel unrepresented and defect.

frames.label: The audience is not human
frames.move: The primary audience is not a person: a system, a process, a record, a place, a successor, an animal, a future reader. Humans get the residue.
frames.must_contain: What humans get from the residue.
frames.characteristic_failure: Nobody can explain it to a person who has to approve it.

frames.label: One hundredth the size
frames.move: Shrink until most of the machinery becomes pointless and see what remains necessary.
frames.must_contain: What survives at the small scale and why it was needed at all.
frames.characteristic_failure: Too small to justify anyone's time.

frames.label: One hundred times the size
frames.move: Grow until the assumptions break, then design for the post-break regime.
frames.must_contain: The threshold where the kind of thing changes.
frames.characteristic_failure: Solves a problem the user will never have.

frames.label: Exactly one of it exists
frames.move: There can only ever be one instance, ever, for everyone.
frames.must_contain: Who administers the single instance and how access is rationed.
frames.characteristic_failure: A bottleneck and a governance fight.

frames.label: One per encounter, then discarded
frames.move: An instance exists for a single interaction and is destroyed afterwards.
frames.must_contain: What carries over, if anything, and how.
frames.characteristic_failure: No accumulation, so it never gets better.

frames.label: It takes a season
frames.move: Stretch the interaction until it cannot be finished in one sitting; the delay is a feature, not a queue.
frames.must_contain: What the waiting party does in the meantime.
frames.characteristic_failure: Abandonment before completion.

frames.label: It is already finished before it starts
frames.move: The result exists before the request; the interaction is about accepting, refusing, or amending it.
frames.must_contain: Where the pre-made result comes from and how wrong ones are handled.
frames.characteristic_failure: Presumption: people resent being pre-decided for.

frames.label: Do the last step first
frames.move: Invert the sequence: commitment before exploration, payment before delivery, review before creation.
frames.must_contain: What makes the inverted order safe enough to accept.
frames.characteristic_failure: Nobody will commit that early.

frames.label: It expires
frames.move: Everything produced here has a stated end date after which it is void, deleted, or must be renewed.
frames.must_contain: The renewal ritual and what lapse means.
frames.characteristic_failure: Churn: renewal friction kills adoption.

frames.label: Someone else pays
frames.move: Move the cost to a party who benefits indirectly, and design for their scrutiny instead.
frames.must_contain: What the payer gets to demand in return.
frames.characteristic_failure: The payer's interest quietly overrides the user's.

frames.label: The price is not money
frames.move: Charge in attention, waiting, vouching, disclosure, labour, or reputation - and state the exchange rate.
frames.must_contain: How the non-monetary price is measured and refunded.
frames.characteristic_failure: Feels exploitative once people compute the real rate.

frames.label: It runs on obligation
frames.move: Participation creates a ledger of favours owed between participants rather than a transaction.
frames.must_contain: How debts are settled, forgiven, or inherited.
frames.characteristic_failure: Social pressure becomes coercive.

frames.label: A shared stock that can be depleted
frames.move: Everyone draws from one pool with an unwritten quota; the design is the quota.
frames.must_contain: What happens as the pool runs low and who notices first.
frames.characteristic_failure: Tragedy of the commons, then rules nobody follows.

frames.label: Designed to be repaired by its users
frames.move: Assume it breaks often and that the people present must fix it without the maker.
frames.must_contain: The repair procedure and the spare parts.
frames.characteristic_failure: Only the technically confident can keep it alive.

frames.label: There is a keeper
frames.move: One named role tends this continuously; the design is mostly the definition of that role.
frames.must_contain: What the keeper does daily and what they may refuse.
frames.characteristic_failure: Does not survive the keeper leaving.

frames.label: Shaped by the handover
frames.move: Design around the moment one caretaker passes it to the next, and what is always lost there.
frames.must_contain: What the handover note must contain.
frames.characteristic_failure: Everything between handovers is undesigned.

frames.label: Wear is visible
frames.move: Use, neglect, and repair leave legible marks that change how the thing is treated.
frames.must_contain: What the marks mean socially.
frames.characteristic_failure: Shaming: the marks become a judgement on people.

frames.label: It works on paper first
frames.move: Design the version that runs with no software at all, then decide what software adds.
frames.must_contain: The paper version's actual procedure.
frames.characteristic_failure: The software version ends up reimplementing paperwork.

frames.label: It exists only in conversation
frames.move: No artefact, no screen: it lives in what people say to each other and in the phrasing they adopt.
frames.must_contain: The sentence people will actually say.
frames.characteristic_failure: Nothing is durable, so nothing compounds.

frames.label: It is a property of a place
frames.move: It cannot be carried; it happens only in a specific room, route, or time of day.
frames.must_contain: What the place contributes that nothing else can.
frames.characteristic_failure: Excludes everyone not there.

frames.label: It lives inside something people already use
frames.move: Nothing new is introduced: it is a change in the behaviour of something that already exists - a tool, a form, a route, a habit, a story people already tell.
frames.must_contain: The exact thing it lives inside, and what it displaces there.
frames.characteristic_failure: Hostage to whatever it lives inside, and to decisions made about that for other reasons.

frames.label: There is an initiation
frames.move: Entry requires a deliberate, slightly costly rite that changes the participant's standing.
frames.must_contain: The rite and what it grants.
frames.characteristic_failure: Gatekeeping that ossifies into exclusion.

frames.label: Commitments are made in public
frames.move: The core act is witnessed by others, and the witnesses have a role afterwards.
frames.must_contain: What witnesses are obliged to do later.
frames.characteristic_failure: Performance replaces substance.

frames.label: There is a way to grieve it
frames.move: Provide a form for endings: closure, retirement, farewell, the reading of what was.
frames.must_contain: What is said and kept when something ends here.
frames.characteristic_failure: Solemnity in a context that did not want it.

frames.label: Repair is a defined procedure
frames.move: Design the exact form of making amends when someone is wronged inside this.
frames.must_contain: Who certifies that repair happened.
frames.characteristic_failure: Procedural apology feels hollow and is gamed.

frames.label: Write the post-mortem first
frames.move: Assume it failed in eighteen months; write the cause, then design the version where that cause cannot occur.
frames.must_contain: The named cause of death and its counter-design.
frames.characteristic_failure: Over-fitted to one failure while others go unexamined.

frames.label: The worst use decides the shape
frames.move: Find the most harmful realistic use and let preventing it determine the architecture.
frames.must_contain: The harm and the structural feature that blocks it.
frames.characteristic_failure: Safety-first design that is joyless to use.

frames.label: The broken state is the design
frames.move: Specify what it does with nothing to run on - no helper, no record, no money, no power, no audience - and make that state dignified.
frames.must_contain: The degraded mode as a first-class experience.
frames.characteristic_failure: Optimized for conditions that rarely occur.

frames.label: Design the exit before the entrance
frames.move: Start from how someone leaves, deletes, or hands off, and work backwards to onboarding.
frames.must_contain: What leaving actually produces for the leaver.
frames.characteristic_failure: Nothing holds anyone. Whatever depended on people staying - habit, membership, momentum - gets weaker.
